learningObjective: Reason about the portability constraints of a serialized TensorRT engine across GPU architectures, driver versions and TensorRT major versions.
stem: Which statements about the portability of a serialized TensorRT engine (plan file) are correct? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Dynamic input shape ranges (optimization profiles) supported by the runtime are baked into the plan at build time; if the runtime feeds a shape outside the built ranges the engine cannot execute it and must be rebuilt.
The plan file is a wrapper around the ONNX file it was built from; deleting the ONNX file makes the plan invalid because the runtime re-parses ONNX on deserialization.

A plan file built for one GPU compute capability (e.g., sm_80, A100) is not guaranteed to run on a different one (e.g., sm_90, H100); the builder emits kernels for the target architecture used at build time.

A plan file built with TensorRT major version X is not generally deserializable by a TensorRT runtime of major version Y ≠ X, because plan serialization is not backward/forward compatible across major versions.

explanation: Plan files are architecture-specific (A), TensorRT-major-version-specific (B), and shape-range-specific (C). D is false: the plan is self-contained — it does not require the source ONNX at runtime.

optionExplanations.A: Correct: optimization profiles are baked in at build.
optionExplanations.B: Wrong: the plan is self-contained and does not need the source ONNX.
optionExplanations.C: Correct: TensorRT documentation states plans are compute-capability-specific.
optionExplanations.D: Correct: cross-major-version compatibility is not guaranteed.

assumptions: Standard TensorRT deployment without explicit version-compatibility mode enabled.
nonImplications: Does not imply cross-arch is never possible; TensorRT has optional 'hardware compatibility' modes that trade performance for wider portability.
Does not imply cross-minor-version is broken; minor-version compatibility is typically maintained.

distractorRationales.B: Fabricates dependency on the source file.
